Bernard is the Construct guardian of the Arcane Tower in the Underdark. Created by the tower's owner, Lenore De Hurst, Bernard was designed for both protection and companionship.
“
New sounds through damp and dark oppression break / Is it the foe, that foul, contemptuous heel?
„
— Bernard, quoting from The Roads to Darkness

Involvement

Act One

Created by the former resident of the tower, Lenore De Hurst, Bernard guards the Arcane Tower on the top level and wields the  Light of Creation.

Bernard speaks only in poetry. If a party member has read the book,  The Roads to Darkness on a desk in the Arcane Tower third floor / bedroom, they get the option to respond in kind with "Or art thou friend, a rescue from my lonely wake?". Optionally a party member can answer in other ways, only one of which causes Bernard to become hostile: "There is light in every living thing. / It's crawling t'wards the surface to survive." Bards have an optional  DC 18 History Check to remember / unlock all verses from the play.

If a party member replies to Bernard with the appropriate line from the play, it acknowledges them as its master. It is then possible to speak additional lines from the play which causes Bernard to take certain actions:

Commands

Line Action Required book
"How can I trust? How will I ever know? / How can I show myself, my darkest me?" Bernard gives  Guiding Light to the player character.  Threadbare Book (first floor / greenhouse)
"These empty sheets are all that's left of you. / The last of all the thoughtless gifts you gave." Bernard gives the player character a  Potion of Greater Healing.  Patched Parchment (table next to Bernard, fourth floor)
"The silence stretches on - I'm all alone. / Please, can I hold your hands, for just a while?" Bernard hugs the player character and reassure them. It speaks as if the player character is Lenore.  Torn-Out Paper (third floor / bedroom)
"Or art thou friend, a rescue from my lonely wake?" Bernard acknowledges the player character as their master, and remains passive.  The Roads to Darkness (third floor / bedroom)
"There is a light in every living thing. / It's crawling t'wards the surface to survive." Bernard and the nearby Animated Armours become hostile and attack.  Evil's Ascent (second floor / main entrance, marked as Dusty Book before reading it)

Choosing any of the first three responses grants the ⁠Heart of the Creator to characters with the  Entertainer background.

Act Three

An  Automaton Component, which appears to be Bernard's head, is on a table in the Steel Watch Foundry. The head cannot be interacted with but the Narrator briefly comments on it. A note next to the head states that a scouting party from  Ketheric Thorm's army found it at the Arcane Tower and delivered it for research.
